cultural_notes: This data comes from the Proceedings of the 39th Siouan and Caddoan Languages Conference
The conference was held at Northeastern State University in Broken Arrow, Oklahoma on May 30-31, 2019
The proceedings include research on multiple Siouan languages including Catawba, Kansa, Umoⁿhoⁿ, Jiwere-Baxoje, and Crow
Published under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License in 2020
The Siouan and Caddoan Languages Conference bridges distances between tribal community members, teachers, learners, scholars and academics
SCLC 39 included presentations on Catawba and various Missouri River, Mississippi Valley, and Ohio Valley Siouan languages
The conference featured formal grammatical and text analysis, comparative phonology, language attitudes and ideologies, language learning materials, and language program updates
A screening of the film Umóⁿhoⁿ Íye: The Omaha Speaking was included in the conference
